title: The Lawyer Who Defended Rats in Court #Shorts
description:
This lawyer's clients were rats. And he almost won. In the early 1500s, around the French city of Autun, rats destroyed the barley crop. The church court ordered the rats to appear. And, as the story goes, it gave them a defence lawyer…
